documentation.content: flatmate-api answered more than 1 request a second with 503 for 5 minutes: instances are full (SERVER_BUSY) or the database is out of connections (SERVICE_BUSY). The web app retries these quietly, but users will notice soon. Look at the Traffic tab (turned away, database connections) and docs/CAPACITY_PLAN.md: raise `API_MAX_INSTANCES` if instances are at the max and the database has headroom; otherwise upgrade the database compute and pooler first.
